eager_replay_vs_historical_caller.gain_boundary: O03 requires validated bounded serialization and measured full-artifact memory/cost evidence. It does not explicitly require a total-process peak reduction or numerical speedup. A common eager-loader peak may hide writer savings; qualify only the measured bounded mechanism and disposition independently supported. No observed saving means NO_DEMONSTRATED_GAIN, never an inferred caller improvement; unexplained regression still requires assessment under original PLAN:74.
eager_replay_vs_historical_caller.invalid_claim: Original live circuit/check/code alias topology, native arithmetic correctness, historical construction memory, full caller peak/gain or closure of every caller output/check. An eager loader peak hiding writer savings is not itself proof of a measured full-process gain.

Symmetric eager loading and separate writer-phase observations may diagnose serializer allocation; total process peaks remain reported.
